elements.description:
A modal for agreeing to terms – the text in sections with a jump list, what changed since the reader last agreed,
required and optional consents, and Accept held until they're met.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the modal is open

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The title, and the dialog's accessible name

properties.name: version
properties.description: The version being agreed to, e.g. "4.0"; it travels on tc-accept

properties.name: effectiveDate
properties.description: When this version takes effect or was last updated, shown as given: "1 November 2026"

properties.name: dateLabel
properties.description: The word before the date – "Effective", or "Last updated"

properties.name: previousVersion
properties.description: The version the reader agreed to before; set, the dialog asks them to agree again and says what changed

properties.name: previousDate
properties.description: When the reader agreed to `previousVersion`, shown as given

properties.name: changes
properties.description: What changed since `previousVersion`, a sentence each, shown above the text

properties.name: sections
properties.description: The text, as sections with headings; the jump list is made from them

properties.name: content
properties.description: The text as one template or DOM node, when it isn't in `sections`; its h2 and h3 headings make the jump list

properties.name: consents
properties.description: The boxes to check – each required or optional

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Which consents are checked, by id

properties.name: requireScroll
properties.description: Accept also waits until the text has been scrolled to the end

properties.name: blocking
properties.description: A must-accept flow: no close button, and Escape doesn't close

properties.name: canDecline
properties.description: Decline is offered (default true)

properties.name: printable
properties.description: Shows Print, which fires tc-print

properties.name: downloadable
properties.description: Shows Download, which fires tc-download

properties.name: pending
properties.description: The app is recording the acceptance: Accept shows `pendingLabel` and nothing else can be pressed

properties.name: error
properties.description: The app couldn't record the acceptance: this message shows with Try again

properties.name: recordAcceptance
properties.description: Records the acceptance after tc-accept; while it runs Accept shows Saving…, it closes the dialog when it resolves

properties.name: describeBlocked
properties.description: Says why Accept is held, in place of the built-in sentences

properties.name: acceptLabel
properties.description: The accept button

properties.name: declineLabel
properties.description: The decline button – "Not now", or "Decline"

properties.name: pendingLabel
properties.description: Accept while the acceptance is recorded

properties.name: errorLabel
properties.default: "Couldn't record your acceptance. Your choices are kept."
properties.description: The error when `recordAcceptance` fails

properties.name: retryLabel
properties.description: The retry button

properties.name: contentsLabel
properties.description: The jump list's name

properties.name: changesLabel
properties.description: The heading over what changed

properties.name: closeLabel
properties.description: The close button's name

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: Asks to open or close; detail `{ open }`. Cancelable – prevented, `open` stays.

events.name: tc-accept
events.description: Accept was pressed with every requirement met; detail `{ version, consents }` (TermsAcceptDetail). Cancelable – prevented, the dialog stays open and nothing is recorded.

events.name: tc-decline
events.description: Decline was pressed; detail `{ version }` (TermsDeclineDetail). Cancelable – not prevented, the dialog closes.

events.name: tc-consent-change
events.description: A consent was checked or unchecked; detail `{ id, checked, consents }` (TermsConsentChangeDetail). Cancelable – prevented, `checked` stays.

events.name: tc-print
events.description: Print was pressed; detail `{ version }`. The app prints.

events.name: tc-download
events.description: Download was pressed; detail `{ version }`. The app provides the file.

functions.name: describeBlocked
functions.description: The default reason Accept is held, in a sentence

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is open – controlled when defined; pair it with `onOpenChange`

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled modal starts open

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog asks to open or close (Escape, the close button, Accept, Decline)

props.name: checked
props.description: Which consents are checked, by id – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Which consents start checked, when `checked` isn't controlled

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with every consent after one is checked or unchecked

props.name: sections
props.description: The text as sections; a body can be text, a DOM node or React content

props.name: children
props.description: The text as React content, when it isn't in `sections`; its h2 and h3 headings make the jump list

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called when Accept is pressed with every requirement met; `event.preventDefault()` keeps the dialog open and records nothing

props.name: onDecline
props.description: Called when Decline is pressed; `event.preventDefault()` keeps the dialog open

props.name: onPrint
props.description: Called when Print is pressed (shown with `printable`)

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called when Download is pressed (shown with `downloadable`)

changelog: **`tc-terms-dialog`:** terms to agree to. - **Changed terms:** re-acceptance opens with a "What's changed" summary, and changed sections are marked. - **Reading:** a jump list that folds into a Contents button. - **Accepting:** required and optional consents; Accept can wait for the end of the text, and says why it's waiting. - **Other actions:** Decline, print and download, plus a blocking mode. - **Saving:** app-driven saving with error and retry.
**Shared code:** - `internal/modal.ts`, the `ModalController` that `tc-dialog`, `tc-terms-dialog` and `tc-stories` share; - `cardHead()` gains `picture`, `pictureShape` and `keepAside`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-color
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default colours.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
